# Temple Scroll Column 12 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 12 | **Condition:** heavily damaged / fragmentary

---

**12:1** [...] On the tenth day of this seventh month [...]

**12:2** [...] you are to gather for a sacred assembly [...]

**12:3** [...] and you must deny yourselves [...]

**12:4** [...] You must not do any work at all [...]

**12:5** [...] for this is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before Me [...]

**12:6** [...] Anyone who does not practice self-denial on this day [...]

**12:7** [...] will be cut off from the people [...]

**12:8** [...] You are to bring a burnt offering to the LORD, a fire offering whose aroma is pleasing [...]

**12:9** [...] one young bull, one ram [...]

**12:10** [...] and seven one-year-old lambs, all without defect [...]

**12:11** [...] Along with their grain offering of fine flour blended with oil — three-tenths of a measure for the bull [...]

**12:12** [...] two-tenths for the ram, and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs [...]

**12:13** [...] Include one male goat as a sin offering, besides the special sin offering for atonement [...]

**12:14** [...] and the regular daily burnt offering with its grain offering and their drink offerings [...]

**12:15** [...] as prescribed — a fire offering whose aroma pleases the LORD [...]

**12:16** [...] This is a lasting requirement wherever you live [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 12 survives only in fragments. The passage prescribes the Day of Atonement — the most solemn day in Israel's calendar. God commands complete cessation from work and self-denial, with the severe penalty of being "cut off" for non-compliance. The sacrificial offerings parallel Numbers 29:7-11. "Deny yourselves" captures the intent of the Hebrew self-affliction formula in accessible English.*
